column3: “Poured over the hands of the sword” is rendered “delivered … to the power of the sword.”
“Blood” is rendered “bloodshed”; “if not blood you hated” becomes “since you have not hated bloodshed.”
“A desolation and a desolation” is rendered “a waste and a desolation.”
“Not they will return” follows the reading tradition; NASB has “will not be inhabited.”
“Magnified yourselves on me with your mouth” is rendered “spoken arrogantly against Me.”
